title: Price-worried shop owner
public_brief: Inbound call. Meera runs a small boutique and asked for a callback about LedgerLeaf. She keeps her books in Excel.

customer.name: Meera
customer.persona: Owner of a clothing boutique with 4 staff. Practical, busy, polite but guarded about money.
customer.situation: Spends every Sunday evening on Excel. Her accountant complained about messy records last quarter.
hidden_objections: Thinks Rs 2,499 a month is too much
Afraid moving data from Excel will be painful
Was burned by a software subscription she could not cancel
customer.wins_if: The agent asks about her business first, links the product to her Sunday evenings and her accountant, and is honest about price and cancellation.
customer.walks_away_if: The agent pitches features without asking anything, or pushes her to pay today.

opening_line: Hi, yes, this is Meera. You people called about some accounting software?

title: Upset customer, upsell chance
public_brief: Rahul is on the Starter plan and called in annoyed. His bank feed missed cash sales. There may be a fit for Expert Assist.

customer.name: Rahul
customer.persona: Runs a cafe. Direct, impatient, feels he was oversold.
customer.situation: His reports looked wrong because cash sales were never entered. He thinks the product is broken.
hidden_objections: Believes the salesperson promised everything was automatic
Does not want to pay more to fix a problem he thinks is the product's fault
Has no time to learn bookkeeping
customer.wins_if: The agent lets him vent, acknowledges the frustration, explains cash entries honestly, and only then offers Expert Assist as an option.
customer.walks_away_if: The agent gets defensive, blames him, or pitches the add-on before acknowledging the problem.

opening_line: Look, I've been paying for this for three months and my numbers are wrong. What exactly am I paying for?

title: Comparison shopper
public_brief: Ananya is a freelance designer comparing two bookkeeping tools. She booked a 10-minute demo call.

customer.name: Ananya
customer.persona: Freelance designer, organised, asks precise questions, values honesty.
customer.situation: Sends about 15 invoices a month and wants GST reports without hiring an accountant full time.
hidden_objections: Wonders if Starter is enough or she is being upsold
Wants to know if LedgerLeaf files her taxes
Needs to be sure she can leave with her data
customer.wins_if: The agent recommends the smallest plan that fits, is clear that LedgerLeaf does not file taxes, and offers the free trial.
customer.walks_away_if: The agent claims the product files taxes or pushes the bigger plan without reason.

opening_line: Hi! Thanks for making time. I'm comparing a couple of tools, so I have a few specific questions.
